YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy.

This website asks only for information relevant to a flag, flagpole, rental or service enquiry.

Information you choose to provide

A quote request may include your name, business, contact details, general location, project requirements and optional files. Do not include payment-card details, identity documents or other sensitive personal information. Only upload files you have permission to share.

How the form works

Information entered in the quote form stays in the current page until you submit it. It is not saved to browser storage. Refreshing or closing the page may remove the entries. If a submission fails, entries remain available in the open form.

Use of enquiry information

Enquiry details are intended to assess the request and coordinate a response. Submitting an enquiry is not consent to unrelated marketing. A service-accepted submission confirms receipt by the form service, not delivery to a particular inbox.

Hosting and technical information

The website is hosted through OpenAI Sites. Hosting providers may process technical request information to operate and protect the service. This site does not add advertising trackers or browser-storage analytics. Anonymous interaction events are available to the page, but no external analytics collector is configured.

Your choices

Provide only the project details needed for an initial discussion. You may request correction or deletion of enquiry information by contacting Waving at (833) 696-9996. File uploads and message delivery depend on the configured enquiry service.
